scientific.integrity: The six corrected state gradients and three control gradients are derived analytically and replayed against centered finite differences in the bundled verification script. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific.limitations: The correction proves a mismatch between the printed controlled model/Hamiltonian and the printed adjoint system. It does not determine which equations, if any, were used in the source numerical implementation, and it does not recompute the full optimal-control trajectories.

title: Correct Pontryagin adjoints for a variable-population SQEIAR media-control model
